infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Allow Unfurl to turn what you say into text as you speak.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Unfurl to use the microphone for dictation and voice captures.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Unfurl to use the microphone for dictation and voice captures.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow Unfurl to turn what you say into text as you speak.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Unfurl to record voice captures.

plugins.photosPermission: Choose a profile picture or capture photo.
plugins.cameraPermission: Take a photo for a capture, or scan a food's barcode to log it.
Take a photo for a capture, or scan a food's barcode to log it.

plugins.calendarPermission: Allow Unfurl to read your calendars to show today's events on Today. Unfurl never changes them.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Unfurl to use your location to record the route of a run or walk you start, and to show local weather.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Unfurl to keep recording the route of a run or walk you started while the screen is locked. Unfurl only tracks you during a session you start.
plugins.motionUsagePermission: Unfurl doesn't use your phone's motion data. This message is required because the location library includes optional motion support.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Unfurl reads your steps, active calories, distance, workouts, sleep and heart rate to show your daily activity and sleep, the steps and heart rate of a workout, run or walk, and, if you choose, add the calories you burned to that day's budget.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Unfurl saves the workouts you finish to Apple Health, with their start and end time, when you turn this on in Fitness settings.
